item.title: Police Find Molotovs, Gas Masks and Drugs at Aristotle University
item.description: Police found Molotov cocktails, poles, anti-gas masks and small quantities of cannabis inside the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki (AUTh) campus following serious clashes that erupted early on Saturday. Authorities carried out searches near the university’s Polytechnic School after violent incidents led to hundreds of detentions. item.description: Greece and Mexico split the opening-day wins in their Davis Cup World Group 1 play-off tie at the Tae Kwon Do venue.
